label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark wins CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Wyndham Clark shot a bogey-free 60 to finish at 30-under, winning THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson by three shots and earning $1,854,000 plus 500 FedExCup points.

items.headline: Scheffler praises Clark's play
items.text: Scottie Scheffler said Clark's 60 was "basically unbeatable," tipping his cap to Clark's nine birdies and one eagle in the final round.

items.headline: Rules delay at CJ CUP
items.text: Clark was denied relief for a ball in standing water by officials, warned for delaying play during a rules dispute in the final round at TPC Craig Ranch.
